sections.title: P16 API profile C layout receipt
sections.text:
Resolved package path after P15.11: `packages/operations` (`corex/operations`). PHP namespace remains `CoreX\Api`. FQCN set is identical before/after (165 classes). GraphQL sweep of `src` is empty.

Mechanical helper: `artifacts/P16-E16b-physical-moves.php`.

Path-sensitive follow-ups (file contents otherwise unchanged except `ToolSchemaWorker` autoload depths): error-contract `source` paths, `AchievedInvariantTest` TrustedContextResolver path, `package-graph-gate.json` import files, `provider-size.json` ToolServiceProvider, API mutation patches, Bulk/Webhook test `__DIR__` requires.

`extra.corex.public-api` unchanged: `CoreX\Api\Contracts`, `CoreX\Api\Data`.

PostgreSQL package cases stay skipped unless `PGSQL_DATABASE` names an isolated `*_test` database (10 skipped / 257 passed on the sqlite package lane, same as P15). `composer dump-autoload -o --strict-psr` still exits 1 on pre-existing test doubles; production class count is 12196.
